summary: test_runner_injects_only_the_subject_task_capability rewrites the credential file to write=[WRITE_TOKEN, ROTATED] before spawn and asserts the mounted snapshot == {'task': capability derived from ROTATED} with no raw read/write tokens in any mounted file, so deriving from the stale/first token or including raw tokens is rejected; the hardening test's raw-token snapshot assertion is a different helper and not the Docker evidence.
